method: Every fine terrain/road/water triangle. Exact Float32 projected edge and face keys; unmatched interior edges sampled on both sides at 1mm then planes projected to their common midpoint. Open edges include valid T-junction partitions and are not automatically holes. Missing support and >2cm plane gaps remain explicit suspicions; no automatic face removal. Separate bridge/building meshes, ray occlusion and arbitrary partial triangle overlaps are not an exhaustive part of this edge audit. Atlas coordinates remain the original metric world-plane shader; no new UV buffer.
